title: Normalized comparisons determined by cartesian functors
statement: Let I be any preorder in universe u, D : I^op → Scheme.{u} a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and c any cone of D. Write C_i and C for the full affine étale categories of D_i and c.pt [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Suppose functors U_ij : C_i → C_j for i ≤ j and v_i : C_i → C, and natural first projections p_ij and q_i on underlying schemes, are supplied. Assume U_ii is the identity and p_ii(A) is heterogeneously equal to the identity of A for every object A. Assume the object squares with top arrows p_ij(A) and q_i(A), vertical structure maps, and bottom arrows D_ji and c_i respectively are pullbacks [def-pc-fibre-product]. No affineness condition on transitions or cone projections, directedness, nonemptiness, or limit property is required. Then there exist natural isomorphisms gamma_ijk : U_ij U_jk ≅ U_ik and delta_ij : U_ij v_j ≅ v_i such that gamma_iik and gamma_ikk are heterogeneously equal to the identity of U_ik, delta_ii is heterogeneously equal to the identity of v_i, and the first projections satisfy gamma_ijk(A).left followed by p_ik(A) = p_jk(U_ij(A)) followed by p_ij(A), and delta_ij(A).left followed by q_i(A) = q_j(U_ij(A)) followed by p_ij(A). No cocycle or site property is asserted.

source.place: 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites), base-change system and the coherence discussion following its proof; parent geometric construction steps 1-3. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EYL.

proof.text: For a chain i ≤ j ≤ k, paste the supplied U_ij and U_jk object squares. Functoriality of D identifies the resulting base arrow with D_ki. The unique comparison with the supplied single U_ik pullback defines the components of gamma. Their first-projection equation is its defining equation. For naturality compare both projections: the first equality is naturality of p_ij and p_jk, and the structure equality follows because the component arrows are over D_k. Pullback uniqueness gives naturality, hence a natural isomorphism.

Paste the supplied U_ij object square with the v_j object square. Cone naturality identifies the base arrow with c_i. The unique comparison with the single v_i pullback defines delta, with its first-projection equation. Naturality follows from naturality of p and q and equality of the structure projections, by pullback uniqueness.

At repeated adjacent indices rewrite U_ii to the identity and use the supplied HEq of p_ii(A) with the identity first projection. The corresponding functor unitors have identity components and the same first and structure projections as the comparison just constructed. Pullback uniqueness identifies the comparison with that unitor. Functor identity-composition equalities identify these unitors heterogeneously with Iso.refl. This gives all three normalization clauses, without assuming a cocycle.

proof_origin.place: Explicit cartesian comparison construction and diagonal normalization underlying 0EYL. First projections and supplied diagonal identity determine the comparison uniquely; no construction of U, v, p, or q remains in this node.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineEtale_normalized_cartesian_comparisons
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (U : ∀ (i j : I), i ≤ j → (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale ⥤
          (D.obj (op j)).FullAffineEtale)
      (v : ∀ i : I, (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale ⥤ c.pt.FullAffineEtale)
      (p : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j),
        U i j h ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op j)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op j)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op j)) ⟶
        fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op i)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op i)))
      (q : ∀ i : I,
        v i ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion c.pt ⋙ Etale.forget c.pt ⋙ Over.forget c.pt ⟶
        fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op i)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op i)))
    (hid : ∀ i : I, U i i le_rfl = 𝟭 _)
    (hpd : ∀ (i : I) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
      HEq ((p i i le_rfl).app A) (𝟙 A.obj.left))
    (hp : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
      IsPullback ((p i j h).app A) ((U i j h).obj A).obj.hom
        A.obj.hom (D.map (homOfLE h).op))
    (hq : ∀ (i : I) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
      IsPullback ((q i).app A) ((v i).obj A).obj.hom A.obj.hom (c.π.app (op i))) :
    ∃ (gamma : ∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k),
        U i j h ⋙ U j k h' ≅ U i k (h.trans h'))
      (delta : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), U i j h ⋙ v j ≅ v i),
      (∀ (i k : I) (h : i ≤ k),
        HEq (gamma i i k le_rfl h) (Iso.refl (U i k h)))
      ∧ (∀ (i k : I) (h : i ≤ k),
        HEq (gamma i k k h le_rfl) (Iso.refl (U i k h)))
      ∧ (∀ i : I, HEq (delta i i le_rfl) (Iso.refl (v i)))
      ∧ (∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k)
        (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        ((gamma i j k h h').hom.app A).hom.left ≫ (p i k (h.trans h')).app A =
          (p j k h').app ((U i j h).obj A) ≫ (p i j h).app A)
      ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        ((delta i j h).hom.app A).hom.left ≫ (q i).app A =
          (q j).app ((U i j h).obj A) ≫ (p i j h).app A)
